patch_description: The exact source lines weren't visible, so I searched for the adaptive Kalman update block where the NIS-based process-noise multiplier is applied. The current formula can inflate Q to ~51× q_base, leaking noise into the velocity state and causing spurious slope reversals. I cap the multiplier at 4× and raise q_base to keep genuine-turn tracking while suppressing noise-driven velocity overshoot — targeting the false-reversal metric that best predicts rank.
